name: Strike-Through → Replace
easing: strike EASE.inOut f6-22; old text fade f22-34 (EASE.out); new text EASE.back f28-46
bestFor: Myth vs reality; 'it's not X, it's Y'; correcting a claim.
keyframeTable: old text centered at y470, nothing else
strike stroke ~25% across the old text
strike complete; old text dimming and rising
old text at ~40% opacity above; new orange text settling
rest: old dimmed+struck at y~430, new orange at y650
script: f6-22: a cream pen stroke (8px) is drawn through the old text, slightly sloped.
f22-34: old text dims to 40% and rises 40px.
f28-46: new text slides up 60px with overshoot, in orange.
colorRules: New text orange (the true side). Old text/strike cream.
